<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">

    <clipPath id="screenClip">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" rx="30"/>

  </defs>

  <g clip-path="url(#screenClip)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#000000"/>

    <!-- Status bar -->
    <text x="22" y="29" font-family="Circular Std, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
    <g fill="#FFFFFF">
      <rect x="325" y="20" width="3" height="5" rx="1"/>
      <rect x="330" y="18" width="3" height="7" rx="1"/>
      <rect x="335" y="16" width="3" height="9" rx="1"/>
      <rect x="340" y="14" width="3" height="11" rx="1"/>
    </g>
    <g fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5">
      <path d="M351 20 C355 16,361 16,365 20 M354 23 C356 21,360 21,362 23"/>
    </g>
    <circle cx="358" cy="25" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="370" y="16" width="18" height="10" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="372" y="18" width="13" height="6" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="388" y="19" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

    <!-- Branded image-led hero -->
    <rect x="0" y="45" width="390" height="520" fill="#ED1B24"/>
    <circle cx="196" cy="306" r="208" fill="#000000"/>
    <circle cx="196" cy="306" r="172" fill="#ED1B24"/>
    <circle cx="196" cy="306" r="139" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="196" cy="306" r="116" fill="#000000"/>

    <circle cx="65" cy="454" r="70" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="65" cy="454" r="43" fill="#ED1B24"/>
    <rect x="111" y="233" width="170" height="142" rx="70" fill="#ED1B24"/>
    <rect x="126" y="247" width="140" height="114" rx="57" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="196" y="296" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Merriweather, Georgia, serif" font-size="19" font-style="italic" font-weight="700" fill="#ED1B24">Coca-Cola</text>
    <text x="196" y="326" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Circular Std, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="2" fill="#000000">OPEN HAPPINESS</text>
    <line x1="145" y1="341" x2="247" y2="341" stroke="#ED1B24" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="350,96 365,125 335,125" fill="#ED1B24"/>
    <circle cx="349" cy="110" r="7" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

    <!-- Header branding -->
    <text x="24" y="80" font-family="Circular Std, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">COCA-COLA</text>
    <g stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round">
      <line x1="348" y1="73" x2="368" y2="73"/>
      <line x1="348" y1="79" x2="368" y2="79"/>
      <line x1="348" y1="85" x2="368" y2="85"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Content panel -->
    <rect x="0" y="542" width="390" height="302" fill="#000000"/>
    <text x="195" y="588" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Circular Std, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="27" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Welcome</text>
    <text x="195" y="615" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Circular Std, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Your refreshment starts here.</text>
    <text x="195" y="637" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Circular Std, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Discover more, one sip at a time.</text>

    <!-- Button shadows -->
    <rect x="45" y="661" width="305" height="58" rx="24" fill="#ED1B24" opacity="0.32" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
    <rect x="45" y="735" width="305" height="58" rx="24" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.28" filter="url(#shadow)"/>

    <!-- Primary button -->
    <g>
      <rect x="45" y="655" width="305" height="58" rx="24" fill="#ED1B24"/>
      <text x="197.5" y="691" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Circular Std, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Get started</text>

    <g>

      <text x="197.5" y="765" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Circular Std, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="700" fill="#ED1B24">Login</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Sign-in prompt -->
    <text x="195" y="816" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Circular Std, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">New here? <tspan font-weight="700" fill="#ED1B24">Sign in as a new user</tspan></text>

    <!-- Bottom navigation -->
    <rect x="0" y="821" width="390" height="23" fill="#000000"/>
    <g stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" opacity="0.72">
      <polygon points="28,828 34,823 40,828 40,836 28,836"/>
      <circle cx="116" cy="827" r="4"/>
      <line x1="113" y1="831" x2="110" y2="836"/>
      <line x1="119" y1="831" x2="122" y2="836"/>
      <circle cx="195" cy="829" r="6"/>
      <line x1="195" y1="821" x2="195" y2="837"/>
      <line x1="187" y1="829" x2="203" y2="829"/>
      <rect x="265" y="823" width="13" height="12" rx="2"/>
      <circle cx="271.5" cy="821" r="2"/>
      <circle cx="350" cy="827" r="5"/>
      <line x1="342" y1="837" x2="358" y2="837"/>
